headline: Parliament approved a bill on improving water supply in Osh region
summary: Deputies of the Jogorku Kenesh approved in second reading a bill ratifying an agreement on financing for a water supply improvement project in Osh region. The project is named in the bill's title.
why: Ratified external financing agreements determine whether state infrastructure projects can proceed and how they are funded, affecting public debt and contractor work.
original_headline: Парламент одобрил законопроект об улучшении водоснабжения в Ошской области
